name: The Lantern Festival
description: Warm amber lanterns mark a season of gathering, with fifteen percent taken from treasured arms, travel leathers, and camp-ready charms.

name: Moonlit Relics
description: For three weeks, relics recovered beneath the pale moon are offered at a quarter less, from whispering rings to bottled starlight.

name: Winterhold Provisioning
description: Prepare for the long road north with ten percent off woolens, warded armour, and restorative draughts chosen by Winterhold guides.

name: Emberwake Clearance
description: The last emberwake caravans have departed. Their remaining fire-forged curios and scarlet tonics were marked down thirty percent before the roads closed.

name: The Verdant Court
description: A spring court of herbalists and fae traders will bring twenty percent savings on green remedies, living wood, and garden-born accessories.

name: Founders' Vault
description: A short archive release opened the oldest vaults for thirty-five percent less, giving collectors one final chance at retired masterpieces.
